title: 蜘蛛网是怎么织出来的
subtitle: 先搭桥，再拉辐条，最后绕圈
character: wearing a light blue t-shirt, grey shorts and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, fine ink pen lines with light transparent watercolour washes, dewy blue grey, pale leaf green and warm amber

pages.zh:
早上的窗角上，
挂着一张新网。
太阳一照丝都亮了，
一圈一圈地绕着。
蜘蛛蹲在正中间。
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up at a window in the morning light, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural, delighted; behind him a round orb web hangs in the corner of the window with a spider at its centre.

pages.zh:
织一张网的第一步
是放出一根丝。
风一吹，丝飘过去，
粘在对面的树枝上。
一座桥就搭好了。

它顺着这根丝
爬到对面的枝头，
又放一根丝回来。
来回走了好几趟，
这座桥才够结实。
pages.scene: One single spider walking along a straight silk thread stretched between two twigs on a cream background, its eight legs gripping the thread. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
它走到桥中间，
往下坠一根丝，
拉住下面的叶子。
三根丝聚在一起，
网的中心就定了。

接着开始拉辐条。
从中心到边上，
一根，又一根，
像车轮上的条。
数一数，三十多根。

辐条拉完了，
它从中心往外绕，
绕出一圈松松的丝。
这圈是临时的，
只是给自己当脚手架。

然后它掉过头来，
从最外圈往里绕。
这一回的丝是粘的，
一圈比一圈密，
一直绕到中心。

有意思的地方在这儿：
辐条的丝不粘，
绕圈的丝才粘。
蜘蛛只踩辐条走，
所以从不粘住自己。

一只小虫撞上来，
翅膀就粘住了。
它一挣，网就抖，
这一抖顺着丝，
传到蜘蛛的脚上。
pages.scene: One small fly caught in the outer rings of an orb web on a cream background, its thin wings stuck fast to the silk. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
网破了怎么办？
它把旧丝吃回去，
再吐出新的来。
一点丝也没浪费，
又变成了一张网。
pages.scene: One single spider sitting on its round web on a cream background, half of the web missing and its loose threads hanging, the spider pulling one old thread towards its mouth, a flat illustration filling the whole picture, not a photograph of an open book. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
织好一整张网，
只要半个钟头。
先搭桥，再拉辐条，
最后一圈一圈绕，
从来不会弄乱。
pages.scene: One complete orb web strung between two branches at dawn on a cream background, tiny dew drops hanging along its threads. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
我凑近看那张网，
丝细得几乎看不见。
这么长的一根线，
是它从自己身上
一点一点抽出来的。
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up leaning in close to a spider web on a garden fence, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural, looking hard at the fine threads.
